scope: Anonymous public retail/commercial product pages and linked terms, read without customer login or account access.

observations.finding: Hong Kong personal FX prices are supplied through SC Mobile or online banking. The public product page publishes membership discounts and examples, but no current personal USD/HKD or USD/CNH bid/ask table.

The directly retrieved current PDF has two pages and was created 2026-09-29. Both pages confirm the Jul-Dec 2026 membership period, USD/HKD spread discounts 11%, 22%, 28%, 33%, and cumulative tiers 10000, 500000, 2000000, 30000000 HKD. The separate Oct-Dec 2026 newcomer campaign offers 100 HKD after 10000 HKD eligible turnover, payable by 2027-02-28. Neither a spread discount nor a conditional future reward supplies a personal execution rate.
observations.decision: Use the actual October PDF, not the search cache's earlier four-page version. Do not add automatic membership discounts or newcomer cash to the calculator. An actual personal execution rate already includes any applicable spread discount; future rewards are not money available in a transfer.

observations.finding: Personal service describes 24/7 exchange and zero separate handling charge. Zero handling charge does not establish a zero FX spread or a public execution rate.
The comparison service is business online banking, using other banks at 09:30 on Hong Kong working days. Reference rates exclude promotions and discounts. It is not this product personal ZA quote.
observations.decision: Do not import a commercial comparison or another bank price as the personal ZA bid/ask.

productChanges: Fix the missing SC Hong Kong retail FX source on funding, HKD return and CNH consumption details; separate mainland and Hong Kong SC evidence records. Prices, eligibility, catalogue and default parameters do not change.
